about: 재고 II 프로젝트계획/실적현황(E040637) — 9월 한 달짜리 프로젝트에 계획 판매 20,000,000 · 구매 10,000,000 과 비용 300,000(경비 실적)을 API 로 넣고 [프로젝트 상세]로 검색하면 원본처럼 '판매 2026.09 20,000,000 · 차이 -20,000,000' · '[판매] 소계' · '[수익] 소계' · '경비 실적 300,000' · '[프로젝트] 손익 예상 10,000,000 · 실적 -300,000'. 기간구분 분기별이면 '2026[3분기]'. 만든 것은 API 로 지운다.

shots.name: 준비 — 프로젝트 · 계획 · 비용(API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async () => { const code = 'QA재고2-PS' + String(Date.now()).slice(-6); const p = await window.__api('POST', '/projects', { code, name: code, startDate: '2026-09-01', endDate: '2026-09-30' }); const pl = await window.__api('POST', '/project-plans', { projectId: p.body.id, planYear: 2026, planRevenue: 20000000, planCost: 0, planPurchase: 10000000, planLabor: 0, planExpense: 0, remark: 'QA재고2' }); const acc = (await window.__api('GET', '/accounts')).body.find((a) => a.name === '소모품비'); const ex = await window.__api('POST', '/expenses', { accountId: acc.id, expenseDate: '2026-09-15', content: 'QA재고2 실적현황', amount: 300000, vatAmount: 0, projectId: p.body.id }); sessionStorage.setItem('pps', JSON.stringify({ code, project: p.body.id, plan: pl.body.id, expense: ex.body.id })); return [p.status, pl.status, ex.status].join(',') })()

shots.name: 상세 · 월별 → 분기별
steps: expect:(() => { const t = document.querySelector('table.ec-report').innerText; return t.includes('2026.09') && t.includes('[판매] 소계') && t.includes('[수익] 소계') && t.includes('-20,000,000') && t.includes('300,000') && t.includes('손익') })()

expect:(() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('table.ec-report tbody tr')].find((x) => x.innerText.includes('손익')); return !!r && r.innerText.includes('10,000,000') && r.innerText.includes('-300,000') })()

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async () => { const s = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('pps')); await window.__api('DELETE', '/expenses/' + s.expense); await window.__api('DELETE', '/project-plans/' + s.plan); const r = await window.__api('DELETE', '/projects/' + s.project); return r.status })()
